goal: Give FBM a repeatable source-only longitudinal annotation intake without converting generator truth or old synthetic labels into MFM gold.
procedure: Rehash the frozen inventory and five original observed source files per selected host. Build cumulative day-1/7/15/30 windows from only dated observed records, withholding whole-run profile until day 30. Record exact parent-file hashes, source-native JSON pointers, canonical derived-unit digests and host/generator lineage. Keep packets unreviewed and exclude event tables, ground truth, upstream QA and v1.5 target files.
decision_criteria: whole pinned 480-host inventory verified against exact source files
1,920 packets and 92,817,429 bytes produced in memory
authority: Preparation code and public synthetic smoke only. No independent gold, model training, complete corpus processor receipt, source rights or product qualification.
validation: MFM four focused tests pass; full 480-host smoke ran in memory and retained no packet file; bash -n passed for CPU Slurm launcher, which remains unrun on Magnolia.
failure_or_lesson: A source inventory does not yet give an annotator temporally bounded evidence. Build past-only windows with original-file lineage, then seek independent source rights and complete target reviews before any full-role fit.
